caseNameFull: Robinson v. Crosby, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections
judges: Application, Execution, Ginsburg, Grant, Souter, Stay, Stevens

opinions.text:
Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Souter, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
